=== MULTI-SOURCE TOPIC CLUSTER: Burnham to set out options next month for long-term EU relationship ===

[Source 1 — www.bbc.co.uk (Bias: Center / Public Broadcaster)] (URL: https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwm2j3nyd44ko?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss):
Burnham to set out options next month for long-term EU relationship

The prime minister says he will set out options for the future "alongside" his 10-year economic plan.

[Source 2 — www.theguardian.com (Bias: Left / Progressive)] (URL: https://www.theguardian.com/politics/live/2026/nov/17/alan-milburn-youth-unempolyment-neets-economy-welfare-brexit-latest-news-updates):
Burnham delays announcement about options for closer relationship with EU until next month – as it happened

The prime minister earlier said he wanted to open a national debate on Britain’s relationship with the blocThis chart, from the Milburn report, shows what is likely to happen to the Neet rate, with or without the Milburn policies.The Alan Milburn report has now formally been published.
